|game_text='''Light Side:''' If just converted, may raise this system to the top.

'''Dark Side:''' If your [[Coruscant (V) (Virtual Block 7){{!}}Coruscant]] system was converted, Force generation +1 here.
|game_text_note=Inferred: the first printing is lost. The game text is that of the re-made sheet; the Dark Side Force icon that the 23 June 2011 errata added is left out (see Errata below).
|errata_history=This is the original printing, '''inferred''' (no Dark Side Force icon; the first printing itself has not been found, and Bill ruled on 10 November 2026 to keep this inferred original). No image of it is known: the image is the slip of the re-made release sheet, which has the same game text but already the Dark Side Force icon added on 23 June 2011 (see [[Coruscant (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]]). The later errata versions are [[Coruscant (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (PC-E1) and [[Coruscant (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): first printing of the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011), not found. Its game text is the same as PC-E1; the Players Committee news post of 23 June 2011 says the errata to Coruscant (V) “restores proper generation ratios to dark decks that normally start their own copy of the Coruscant system. Prior to this errata, decks like Agents of Black Sun and Hunt Down (V) would lose an icon from their system”<ref name="src-S6">Players Committee news post "5 immediate changes from the CBT", 23 June 2011 (immediate). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110824051300/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=323:5-immediate-changes-from-the-cbt&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref>, so the first printing had one Dark Side Force icon fewer (read here as none). No image of the first printing is known.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Coruscant (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]]): the news post of 23 June 2011 gives the card with Light (2) and Dark (1) Force icons<ref name="src-S6" />, and the re-made Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet prints it<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; this copy was re-made on 25 July 2011, after the errata of 23 June 2011; the first printing has not been found). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: Light Side “If just converted, may raise this system to the top.”; Dark Side “If your Coruscant system was converted, Force generation +1 here.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-p7-122-Coruscant_Special_Edition.png]]) prints it. The same Competitive Balance Team errata was posted on the Players Committee rules forum on 22 June 2011, effective immediately, a day before the news post<ref name="pcforum-p632630">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 22 June 2011 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p632630 forum post])</ref>.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Coruscant (V) (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]]): Advanced Rulebook 2.0, Appendix A has “your Force generation is +1 here” on the Dark Side<ref name="ar20">[[Media:AR-version-2-0-final.pdf|Players Committee Advanced Rulebook 2.0]], Appendix A (Errata), p. A-5; PDF created by 27 August 2012 (announced earlier on the Players Committee rules forum; see the history above). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2013/04/ar_version-2-0_final.pdf</ref>; the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the same<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: Light Side “If just converted, may raise this system to the top.”; Dark Side “If your Coruscant system was converted, your Force generation is +1 here.” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-41-front-master.png]]) prints it. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-coruscant-pre.gif]], E-marked; server file date 25 February 2013) shows the Light Side only (“If just converted, may raise this system to the top.”) and prints no Dark Side text; there is no Players Committee image of the Dark Side (an earlier note here read a third Dark Side wording into it, which the image does not print). The Players Committee posted this change on its rules forum on 15 March 2012 (“Slight tweaked the errata for Coruscant (V) from last year. I noticed that the generation bonus for the Dark Side player was accidentally given to both players previously”)<ref name="pcforum-p701271">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 15 March 2012 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=40#p701271 forum post])</ref>, so this version dates from then. The forum copy of the 22 June 2011 post now also reads “your Force generation”; forum posts can be edited later.
